packageRules.description: Version updates and lock file refreshes run chart publish

Group k8s.io/*, controller-runtime, controller-tools, Helm v4, and OCM together — they share k8s library dependencies and must use the exact same version; bumping any one without the others breaks the build

No digest updates for kube-openapi: it has no releases, so its digests follow Kubernetes master and can need newer libraries than the pinned k8s.io/* minor (structured-merge-diff v7 vs v6 broke artifact-conduit). The k8s group bump moves it via go mod tidy instead
Include envtest Kubernetes version (ENVTEST_K8S_VERSION in Makefile) in the same group; version is capped by kindest/node availability
